_note: What this machine IS. "role" decides which half of the rest applies. server: distributeClients, distributeBacklog, distributeWaitMs, distributePort. client: serverHost, clientId, clientCropShare, clientImageFolder. What a client KEEPS (full images, budgets) is not set here: it follows the server's <spec>\common\storage.json. discoveryPort is used by both. The half that does not apply is KEPT, not deleted, so changing role does not lose it. serverHost "auto" means find a server on this network; a host name or address pins this machine to that server and no discovery runs.
